title: Standing Automatic Payment of a Fixed Monthly Sum on Personal Credit Cards
content:
A cardholder may ask the Customer Care Center to put a standing automatic payment instruction on a personal credit card account for a fixed monthly amount, and this rule fixes what that amount is. It governs cards under Personal Credit Cards.

**When the amount is settled.** The fixed monthly amount of a standing automatic payment instruction is settled only after every billing dispute standing in submitted status on the card account carries its temporary credit entry in the ledger. That amount is settled only once no temporary credit remains outstanding on a billing dispute the card account records as resolved against the cardholder.

**Where the rule does not reach.** A cardholder who asks for a standing instruction on an account whose payable balance is zero is out of scope of this rule and no fixed monthly amount is set.

**How the instruction is recorded.** The instruction is recorded by `set_card_autopay_amount_b2f02f74`, a tool the agent unlocks and then hands over for the customer themselves to run, the standing instruction being the cardholder's own. One call replaces whatever automatic payment instruction the card account carries with a fixed monthly sum, records the sum, and names the Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account the money will be taken from each month. The cardholder sees the instruction and its amount on the card account from then on, and the named checking account is what the monthly debit will come out of.

**Parameters.**

- `card_account_id` — the reference number of the credit card account the standing instruction is placed on; it is read from the card account lookup for this cardholder before the call. An identifier.
- `autopay_source_account_id` — the reference number of the Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account the monthly sum is taken from; it is read from the checking account lookup for this cardholder before the call. An identifier.
- `autopay_amount` — the fixed sum taken each month, expressed exactly as the card account records a money amount: US dollars to 2 decimal places, always a positive number carried to 2 decimal places and rounded half-up. The figure itself is passed, never a share of a balance.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the card account reference number, states the standing instruction now in force as a fixed monthly sum, repeats that sum in US dollars to two decimals, and names the checking account reference number the money will come from. A sentence of that shape means the instruction is recorded; anything beginning with Error means nothing was written.
